Do you not resent me, boy? All I have done is use you.
Well, thanks to you, I found what I needed.
strings.대공이 기다리던 날이 얼마나 남은 거야?: How long until the day you've been waiting for?
So that is what you wished to know. It will be 'soon.'
strings.어떻게 돕는단 말입니까?: And how would you do that?
strings.어차피 제가 갈 그곳에서 소년이 할 수 있는 일은 없습니다…. 당신은 그: There is nothing you could do where I am going... The moment you set foot there, you would vanish without a scrap of flesh remaining...
That is why there is someone else I must summon...
A flower grown from a seed I took out of the mirror and planted. Cold, yet warm.
strings.이번에도 절 배신할지는 모르겠지만, 그곳에서는 차마 그러지 못할 겁니다…: I do not know whether I will be betrayed again, but that will hardly be possible there...
strings.(바르바토스가 꽃을 꺾어 그대로 품 안에 집어넣는다.): (Barbatos plucks the flower and tucks it inside his coat.)
strings.알 수 없는 말로 거절하는군. 알겠어. 그러면 대공은 이제 신이 되는 거: Turning me down with riddles, huh? Fine. So are you going to become a god now?
I was a god from the beginning. This form I now wear...
strings.참 설명하기 번거롭군요. 정 날 돕고 싶다면 조용히 숨어 계세요. 그리고: What a bother to explain. If you truly wish to help me, stay quietly in hiding. And try not to die before we meet again, nameless boy.
strings.언제까지 '이름 없는 소년'이라 부를 수도 없는 노릇이니… 선물을 드리겠: I cannot keep calling you 'nameless boy' forever... Allow me to give you a gift.
The name of someone who was as fine a warrior as Atalante.
strings.(바르바토스가 노네임의 어깨를 두드리고는 풍차 위로 뛰어올라 높은 하늘을: (Barbatos pats No Name on the shoulder, leaps onto the windmill, and vanishes as though flying into the sky.)
Just when I think I understand that man... Oh, he's not a man. Not a demon, either...
Meleager... Meleager... A little hard to pronounce, but I think I could get used to it.
It's me, Lydia. Caluso, I told you to stop swinging your fists at everything.
strings.매직로드로 잘 막아 냈으면서 엄살은…. 그래서 바쁘신 데미갓께서 무슨 일: You blocked it with your Magic Rod well enough. Stop complaining... What brings our busy demigod here? Daniel and Romalius should be in the village.
This is more important than checking on those two. I need your help, Caluso.
It's an honor to meet you, sir.
strings.선배는 무슨. 무슨 일이기에 도크알프 사제까지 불렀지?: No need for that. What is so serious that you've brought a Dokkalf priest along?
strings.칼루소 아저씨, 여기는 불멸의 사제단 에이스이자 최연소 5급 사제 아스크: Caluso, this is Askren, the Immortal Priesthood's ace and its youngest fifth-rank priest.
strings.일에 미쳤군. 얼마나 일을 했으면 벌써 5급이야?: A workaholic, then. How much work did you do to reach the fifth rank already?
strings.아스크렌 사제, 여기는 마수 퇴치 1만 마리 업적에 빛나는 전설의 전투: Priest Askren, this is Caluso, the legendary battle priest famed for slaying ten thousand magical beasts.
strings.마수 1만 마리를 퇴치하시다니 대단하시군요. 전 무서워서 손도 못 대는데: Ten thousand magical beasts? That's incredible. I'm too scared to lay a hand on one...
If you're gathering people like this, it must be something serious...
Lady Iris has delivered an oracle to %s.
strings.내가 해야 할 일은?: What do you need me to do?
You aren't going to ask anything else, sir?
Unlike a certain someone with less substance than air.
I won't ask for more, but I should at least know where we're going.
All right. I'll tell you. Our destination is...
Linford, a fragment of the Celestial Realm known as the City of Angels.
